comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Just in case anybody passes through the comments here and is left wondering, I've checked the Quest Information button in the game, and the only pre-quests it shows are Golden Fruit and Monster Bird, just like the guide says. 10-star quests typically fall under the 'rare' category, so even 200 QMPs, all skill requirements, and a stockpile of SQMPs aren't a guarantee that they'll appear right away, if at all. It's all just part of the business called adventure.
